population_definition: Technical section1.3 restricts commuters to routine same-day movement crossing regency/city residence boundaries. Section1.4 uses the main activity occupying most time. Section1.12 includes vehicle waiting, excludes time spent at intermediate stops.
reason: Separate current-stage and all-commuter duration margins do not identify the high-school joint distribution; within-boundary students are not covered by the commuter population.
